subject: Geopolitics
title: Cyberattacks on Energy Infrastructure
description: One-minute skill: Cyberattacks on Energy Infrastructure.

hook.text: In 2021, a ransomware attack shut down the Colonial Pipeline. Gas stations across the US East Coast ran dry in days.

buildup.text: Energy grids, pipelines, and refineries are increasingly digital. Every connection is a potential attack vector.

discovery.text: State-sponsored hackers target energy infrastructure for espionage and sabotage.

twist.text: Stuxnet, a US-Israeli worm, destroyed Iranian centrifuges in 2010. Cyber weapons cut both ways in energy conflicts.

climax.text: Energy infrastructure is the new battlefield. A well-placed cyberattack can cause more chaos than a missile.

punchline.text: Hack a pipeline and a nation goes dark.

quiz.question: What did the Colonial Pipeline attack demonstrate?
options: Physical attacks are more effective than cyber ones
Cyberattacks can cripple critical energy infrastructure
US energy infrastructure is immune to hacking
